originality.rationale: Literature-led gap: the 2026 arXiv:2609.05647 result classifies maximal minimal-polynomial degree for characteristic-zero matrix Rota–Baxter operators; its Theorem 1.1 does not imply rank-one, square-zero linear operators. The 2018 arXiv:1801.07037 Theorem 6 gives M2 classes over algebraically closed characteristic-not-two fields; it does not give all n or finite-field raw counts. Searches in published-finding corpus and public literature for trace tensor normal forms, rank-one all-n classification, and counts did not reveal stronger coverage.
